title: Safety Study of Anti-IgE Immunotherapy in Allergic Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate safety and efficacy of three doses and two dosing regimens of RP01 as an anti-IgE immunotherapy in allergic patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Allergy to at least one aero allergen
* Increased serum IgE level

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of asthma
* Recent use of systemic corticosteroids or immunosuppressive treatment
* Allergy vaccination therapy
